primitives.name: Context-Adjusted Expected Points Added
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Context-adjusted EPA as a reordering metric.** r=1.000 with raw EPA on four successive bases; 0.998 even with leave-one-out defensive quality.
primitives.assumptions: Linear correlation between raw and context-adjusted EPA holds under leave-one-out defensive quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When defensive quality is omitted, correlation drops slightly from 1.000 to 0.998.

layer2.mapping: EPA reordering maps to GSI's Bayesian score calibration for outcome prediction.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation coefficient r between raw and adjusted EPA values.

primitives.name: Motion as Coverage Predictor
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Motion as a coverage predictor.** Coverage null (p=.091 binary, .128 8-class, .687 on 3rd/4th).
primitives.assumptions: Motion patterns are statistically independent of coverage type in binary classification.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Null hypothesis rejected for binary case (p < 0.1), but not for multi-class or down-specific cases.

layer2.mapping: Motion filters used in GSE to refine coverage model inputs before state transition.
layer2.telemetry: Statistical significance p-values for motion vs. coverage type.

primitives.assumptions: Speed differences are indicative of decision-making under pressure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Speed increases with interception likelihood, suggesting higher risk-taking.
